title: Metro Cebu air quality hits ‘acutely unhealthy’ level anew
summary: MANILA – Air quality in Metro Cebu reached the “acutely unhealthy” level anew on Saturday, with the Environmental Management Bureau (EMB) recording an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 238 as of 7 a.m.
